Intel (INTC) vs Broadcom (AVGO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 44.1 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — INTC: $52.9B · AVGO: $63.9B
• Revenue growth — INTC: −0.5% · AVGO: +23.9%
• Operating margin — INTC: −4.2% · AVGO: 39.9%
• Net margin — INTC: −0.5% · AVGO: 36.2%
• Free cash flow margin — INTC: −9.4% · AVGO: 42.1%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — INTC: −9.6% · AVGO: 23.5%

Different fiscal years: INTC Dec 27, 2025 · AVGO Nov 2, 2025. The periods are not identical.
